#!/bin/sh
# WAN 在启动等待结束后才上线时，补启动已启用的校园网认证服务。
[ "$ACTION" = "ifup" ] || exit 0
[ "$INTERFACE" = "wan" ] || exit 0
/etc/init.d/esurfingclient enabled || exit 0
[ -n "$(/usr/bin/esurfingclient --list-accounts 2>/dev/null)" ] || exit 0
/etc/init.d/esurfingclient running && exit 0
ip -4 route show default | grep -q '^default ' || exit 0
mkdir /var/run/esurfing-wan-start.lock 2>/dev/null || exit 0
(
    trap 'rmdir /var/run/esurfing-wan-start.lock' EXIT
    /etc/init.d/esurfingclient running || /etc/init.d/esurfingclient start
) </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 &
exit 0
